name: OX Quiz Widget
description: Mobile-first educational OX (true/false) quiz interface that presents one question at a time with answer feedback, explanations, and progress tracking

requirement.summary: An OX quiz widget for an educational mobile app. Users view questions one at a time, select O or X, receive immediate correct/incorrect feedback with explanations, track their progress, and can retry the quiz.
details: Display the OX quiz question list one question at a time
Provide O and X answer buttons for the user to select an answer
After selection, show whether the answer is correct and display the correct answer with an explanation
Lock answer buttons after selection to prevent changing the answer for the current question
Provide a control to advance to the next question after feedback is shown
Display progress (e.g., '3/10 questions completed') with a visual progress bar
Show a completion summary (score, correct/incorrect count) when all questions are answered
Provide a 'Retry' feature that resets all state and restarts the quiz from the first question
Component structure: QuizContainer (overall layout), QuestionCard (current question), AnswerButtons (O/X selection), ProgressBar (progress indicator), ResultDisplay (correct/incorrect feedback)
State management: current question index, user answers, correctness per question, and quiz completion status
Responsive design optimized for mobile and tablet viewports
Transition animations between questions and when revealing feedback (Tailwind transition/animation utilities)
Accessibility: full keyboard navigation (Tab focus, Enter/Space to activate, optional O/X shortcut keys), visible focus states, ARIA labels on buttons, and aria-live announcements for feedback
Color scheme: green for correct answers, red for incorrect answers, gray for neutral/unselected states
Use the system default font stack
Include sample quiz data (e.g., 10 questions with answers and explanations) embedded in the component
